description: We code a game for children to play. It will be fun and realistic so go in and join with us.
summary:
Our mission is to bring the amazing journey of NASA's Mars and Moon rovers to life through an interactive game.
Players can explore the Martian surface, discover mysterious rocks, and learn about the challenges and scientific discoveries of these incredible rovers.
We hope our project will make space exploration more fun, exciting, and educational.
details:
Rover Odyssey is a pixel-art browser game that retells the journeys of NASA’s rovers across three chapters: Opportunity and Spirit on Mars, and the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle on the Moon.

Players drive the rover through each part of the mission and face real events such as dust devils, dust storms, memory faults, a damaged wheel, and a battery that can’t be recharged. Along the way they collect memory fragments (glowing yellow sparks) that unlock short stories with NASA archive photos, gather rock samples, play small mini-games, and track objectives in a notebook.

A small map in the top-left corner shows real imagery of Mars or the Moon and scrolls with the rover’s position, alongside a HUD showing power, distance traveled, and a mineral signal. The game defaults to English, supports several languages, and includes accounts, pause, and saved progress.

It is a demo (MVP) for education and science outreach: the models are simplified, and the distances on the map are exaggerated so movement is visible.
